families.source_effect: Different current/capture streams require the original wait_stream producer ordering. Same stream needs no new cross-stream edge.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Fusion/repartition may change granularity, but cannot drop a producer-ready fence merely because a graph pointer or output shape is stable.

families.source_effect: Dummy attention metadata is built iff force_attention or runtime mode FULL; is_profile is passed but not read by this base predicate.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: A torch profiler being active is not the _dummy_run is_profile argument. Preserve override selection; metadataNone is not an all-model no-op certificate.

families.source_effect: Encoder-only early return and valid runtime mode assertion remain before downstream work.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Outside the current text-model domain preserve baseline branches and errors; do not expand framework validation as a kernel-research task.

families.source_effect: Uniform decode partitions ceil(T/q) requests with an exact short final request; profile_cpp uses one request; ordinary mode balances across min(T,Rmax). create_mixed raises.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Preserve ordered per-request token counts and row ownership. T=0 is not licensed as a valid helper invocation by this body; unchanged errors remain. Shape or total count equality does not prove request identity.

families.source_effect: EPLB hooks surround work; DP padding uses repeat in eager NONE and np.pad otherwise; padded token/request domains are distinct.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Fuse input/metadata generation only from the same authoritative ordered schedule. Keep allocated/sent/received rows separate and heat/owner updates if enabled; no full-buffer hoist from stable capacity.

families.source_effect: Built metadata selects DecodeOnly except MTP/MLA alternatives, chooses profile/PA/default lengths, permits DCP adjustment, writes current valid lengths and clears the remaining length bank before copy.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: A combined metadata kernel may directly emit the final padded bank only if every consumed tail, DCP ownership and copy-ready edge is preserved. DSpark and MTP are different domains; no whole-schedule default substitution.

families.source_effect: Cumsum/start-location/GDN buffers have separate shapes; GDN skip emits zero starts. Circular cache groups may reset block table and per-layer cache state before commit.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Partial bank writes require invalid-tail invariants. Do not reuse across groups/layers/generations from equal count; circular state clears and commit are observable writes, not dummy bookkeeping.

families.source_effect: Outside capture every group slot map is filled -1; capture clears a prefix only for the stated uniform DeepSeekV41 cache groups.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Sentinel initialization can fold into a full final writer or generation-aware virtual representation; cannot delete if any native/cache/other-layer reader can observe stale valid slots. Prefix-only and full-bank extents differ.

families.source_effect: Compressed attention publishes position127 to device and CPU buffers; alternative position-using path clears a prefix. Metadata build consumes padded/unpadded/request/group descriptors.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Constant position specialization may share position-derived work under exact dtype/order/config keys, but cache/slot effects and all consumers remain. Both CPU and device banks and copied epochs must agree.

families.source_effect: Dummy LoRA context receives scheduled/sample counts,remove_lora and configured max_loras or requested active count.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Adapter/weight generations and graph specialization are part of the value key. Preserve active-adapter context and restoration; identical base model weights or zero local requests do not authorize folding different adapter states.

families.source_effect: Select input IDs or embedding bank and ordinary/mRoPE position views under the actual feature guards.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: A public fused producer must keep valid extents and selected representation. Identical shape does not establish equal IDs, embedding values or multimodal expansion.

families.source_effect: First PP rank has no intermediate tensor input; later stages allocate/view an intermediate bank, with ceil(T/TP) rows under SP.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Repartition must keep stage and row-owner contracts; no free global visibility or pre-padded logical row count. Current PP1 can bypass only the non-first-stage domain when configuration is bound.

families.source_effect: INT32 zero indices of length Rmax*uniform_decode_query_len are allocated; both callbacks read them only when need_dummy_logits is true, and draft callback also requires its model method.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Guarded dead index allocation when no callback demands it; if demanded, repeated index0 is a conditional same-row head-work reuse opportunity. Keep all collectives and original output dimensions, precision/readers and publication. No blanket dummy head skipping.

families.source_effect: Forward context carries graph mode, model instance, sinks and optional EPLB heat; forced top-k is built only under its full non-capture/MoE/config guard.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Route IDs/counts, heat and expert state are not ordinary discardable outputs. Keep original before/after state protocol and peer participation.

families.source_effect: An in-flight metadata submission is released after model forward.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Release is tied to actual submission/consumer readiness. A pending writer as well as a last reader can prevent bank reuse; pointer/descriptor equality is insufficient.

families.source_effect: Auxiliary outputs change tuple unpacking; the selected hidden bank feeds target/draft heads.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Demand pruning retains all required auxiliary/KV/state readers and precise output contract, not only the sampled rows.

families.source_effect: Draft dummy_run occurs when drafter exists and not profile_cpp; receives padded counts, DP counts, descriptor/mode and in_graph_capturing=not force_attention.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Preserve DP/EP participation, all receiver expert work and KV/state publication. The argument called in_graph_capturing here is not independently inferred from the ambient profiler or outer eager mode.

families.source_effect: Profile and non-profile paths clear/adapt or finish EPLB state differently.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: No state elimination from absent sampled outputs. Keep logical step and expert/parameter generations; warmup profiling and actual serving gains are separate.

families.source_effect: Compressed forced-attention path resets device positions and CPU position buffer to0 after use.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Combining set127/work/reset requires retaining the working value until all readers retire and restoring both banks. Replacing it by permanent0 or hoisting across calls is invalid without a stronger consumer certificate.

families.source_effect: Encoder-only returns empty; otherwise select the final hidden row of each scheduled request then compute logits.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: This helper does not itself run the random sampler. Do not confuse it with real sampling, or infer raw/logprob/entropy readers dead from its name.

families.source_effect: Optional sparse-KV-offload profiling buffers use existing cache specs or query them.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Startup/profile allocation sizes are not steady-state per-request HBM work or universal necessary bytes. Preserve the applicable cache ownership/capacity contract.

families.source_effect: When full token capacity exceeds MC2 capacity and selected comm is MC2/FUSED_MC2, run a compilation-disabled capped dummy profile before parent profiling.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Allocated launch rows and receiver expert work remain distinct. A profile/cold-start cost is not repeated serving savings; no transfer of capped workspace identity to later captured graph banks.

families.source_effect: Only dynamic,not-yet-warmed EPLB initializes adaptor/loader/updater and warmup state.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: This is parameter/state setup with one-time guards; preserve its state/error order and do not count it as an every-iteration fusion win.

families.source_effect: Engram capture-active flag is reset in finally even when capture raises; wrappers select the parent capture implementation.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Successful-graph optimization must still keep exception cleanup and capture visibility; do not extend temporary capture state into future serving.

families.source_effect: Encoder graph manager update stream is rebound only if manager and stream exist.
families.fusion_split_reorganization_contract: Retain graph-owned stream/order compatibility. A stable graph descriptor is not native parameter or weak-reference lifetime proof.
